name: LEXA canonical source archive

source_baseline.note: This archive includes the Prisma and worker transaction-local Neon runtime-role correction and the current Render/Neon compute configuration. It is a source archive, not a GitHub commit or deployment.
source_baseline.archive_basis: Updated from the supplied 2026-11-02 source archive and reconciled with the production configuration supplied as directly verified on 2026-11-03; not a byte-for-byte export of main.

github_repository_requirements.reason: The repository-import workflow rejects .github/ in an incoming source ZIP. Keep the workflow in the GitHub repository; do not delete or relocate it.

deployment.render_health_check_note: Do not set a healthCheckPath until deployed GET /health/ready has been verified to return HTTP 200.

worker_redis_status.production_requirement: Do not enable worker processing until a current authenticated persistent private Redis/Key Value service is verified.

database.migrations: 30 existing migration directories retained; no production migrations run for this archive

production_runtime_role_verification.method: read-only query on production branch; no business data queried or changed
production_runtime_role_verification.worker_queue_discovery: Uses the privileged lexa_app login for narrowly scoped queue/control metadata; hardening follow-up is constrained claim functions or a dedicated NOLOGIN NOBYPASSRLS role.

secrets: No live .env files, database credentials, production connection strings, provider keys or tokens included.

dependency_installation.reason: The source-import ZIP excludes generated/dependency artifacts. scripts/clean_repository.py generates missing npm lockfiles with npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts before repository validation and npm ci.
dependency_installation.ci_requirement: Run scripts/clean_repository.py before scripts/validate_repository.py and before npm ci. The cleanup step verifies lockfileVersion and exact package.json root dependency metadata.
